title: Large escalators and staircases
content: I just found out about this sub, and since dreams have fascinated me since forever, I thought I'd share my recurring ones. Whenever I dream about being in a mall, or in my old schools, escalators and staircases always seem to play a big part in it. For malls, it's always absurdly long escalators, and in any other location (mostly schools, though other locations, including malls, have shown up in my dreams, too) it's staircases. One constant of all my dreams involving them are that, in the dream, I know them to be staircases and escalators, but in practice, they are anything but - empty frames missing steps, escalators that impossibly loop around and are turned off, things that are more reminiscent of an euclidean-shaped ramp than stairs proper. They are always exceedingly difficult to climb up, too. Does anyone else's dreams also seem to involve a lot of stairs - or what should be stairs, anyway?
